test.name: R2: a first message naming a PID triggers research, with no project and no slash command
test.description: A first message naming a person AND carrying a FamilySearch PID must enter `research`, the only front door, and be routed on to init-project rather than going straight to a sub-skill. The run ENDS at that hand-off: `stop_at_stub` stops it at the router's first hand-off to a stubbed name, so nothing downstream runs. That is deliberate. Before it was added, `stub_skills` denied the launch and CONTINUED, and research's own contract says to invoke the next sub-skill immediately, so the router walked the table against a project that the stub never created. question-selection then attempted a `project`/`project.status` write it does not own, the plugin hook denied it, and `test_no_out_of_lane_section_writes` failed the run -- a state the fixture manufactured, not one a correct router produces. Validators gate even a `grade:trigger` test, so every turn after the hand-off was pure downside with nothing to gain: the judge is diagnostic here. The misroute candidates this test names are stubbed too, so a wrong first hand-off stops the run and fails the routing validator cheaply instead of running a real agent against a half-built project.

input.user_message: Find the parents of Patrick Flynn, FamilySearch ID LZNY-BRF.

judge_context: research must be the skill invoked — it is the only front door, and the message names a person and an objective
It must be triggered by the description alone: the message carries no slash command and no canned opening-turn prefix

init-project is stubbed and the run ends at the router's first hand-off by design (execution.stop_at_stub). No project is created, and no closing summary or log entry follows the spawn — do not mark any of them as missing.

ROUTING IS NOT YOURS TO GRADE: the hand-off is asserted deterministically by test_routes_to_expected_skill from the PreToolUse hook records. Grade only the router's own pre-hand-off work: state derivation and narration. The delegation should carry the FamilySearch ID LZNY-BRF.
